caption: The drawing shows three views of a single intricately designed object resembling a trivet or a flat iron stand. The primary object is shown in a large, angled perspective in the lower right quadrant, displaying a triangular, leaf-shaped form with openwork patterns, including circular and teardrop motifs, and a textured or rope-like border. The handle is elongated with a loop at the end and similarly textured. In the upper center, there is an overhead plan view of the object, depicting the same overall shape and decorative elements. Below this, a simple side profile of the object is drawn, indicating its thin, flat structure with small feet for elevation. A short ruler graphic is included for scale, marked in standard increments. The artwork is rendered in pencil or graphite on a light beige background, emphasizing the grey tones and shading of the metal-like object.
title: Flat Iron Holder
